body_en: The planet is not a rubbish bin. Reduce waste, reuse bags, recycle right. Save water and power at home with small daily habits. Walk or bike for short trips when you can. Local action adds up when many people join.
body_zh: 地球不是垃圾桶。减废、重复用袋、正确回收。家里用小习惯节水节电。短途能走或骑车就走。许多人一起，本地行动才会加总。
